faq.title: Everything You Need to Know Before We Start
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to common questions about working with an independent software developer, intellectual property, collaboration, and project delivery.
faq.q1: How do we coordinate communication and time zones?
faq.a1: I am based in Noida, India (UTC+5:30) and regularly coordinate working hours with teams in North America (EST/PST), Europe (GMT/CET), and the Asia-Pacific region. I overlap 4 to 6 hours daily with US and European business hours for synchronous meetings, Slack/Discord messaging, and quick check-ins, supported by daily asynchronous video walkthroughs via Loom.
faq.q2: Who owns the intellectual property and code?
faq.a2: You own 100% of the code, intellectual property, documentation, and design assets. Upon milestone completion and final payment, full repository ownership is transferred directly to your organization. I never retain proprietary rights to your business code.
faq.q3: Can you work with our existing codebase and internal engineering team?
faq.a3: Yes. I regularly integrate into existing Git workflows, follow your team’s pull request review processes, adhere to established architectural patterns, and collaborate smoothly on Jira, Linear, or GitHub Projects. I take pride in leaving codebases cleaner and better documented than I found them.
faq.q4: How do you estimate costs and project timelines?
faq.a4: During our initial discovery phase, we break down your application into clear functional milestones with explicit deliverables. I provide a fixed-scope proposal with guaranteed milestone deadlines and fixed pricing. There are never surprise billing invoices or hidden expenses.
faq.q5: What happens if we discover a bug after the project launches?
faq.a5: All fixed-price development projects come with an included 30-day post-launch warranty. If any bug or issue emerges within the agreed project scope during this period, I resolve it promptly at zero additional cost.
faq.a6: You can send a direct inquiry through the contact form below or book a 15-minute intro discovery call. We will review your product requirements, discuss technical feasibility, and put together a clear implementation roadmap.
